/docs/machine-learning/boosting.title: Boosting: AdaBoost & Gradient Boosting, In Full Depth

From-scratch DBSCAN matches scikit-learn exactly.

/docs/machine-learning/decision-tree.title: Decision Trees, In Full Depth

UMAP's fuzzy graph and cross-entropy. What their plots can and can't be trusted for, measured on real data.

/docs/machine-learning/k-nearest-neighbo.title: K-Nearest Neighbors, In Full Depth

/docs/machine-learning/kmeans-hierarchic.title: K-Means & Hierarchical Clustering, In Full Depth

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Parse incremental streamed token chunks into live reasoning thoughts and dispatched action calls.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Fault Tolerant Agent Runner
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Implement retry logic with backoff boundaries to guarantee fault-tolerant agent execution across flaky networks.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Agent Step Budget
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Track and enforce execution step limits to guard autonomous agents against runaways and infinite loops.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Self Healing Agent Step
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Repair malformed tool invocations in response to execution feedback using reflection and heuristic correction.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Loop Termination by No Progress
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Implement stagnation detection by monitoring state progression history across a configurable patience window.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Repeated Tool Call Detector
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Detect degenerate tool repetition loops where an agent calls the same tool with identical parameters repeatedly.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Agent Loop Replay
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Reconstruct and verify agent state by replaying deterministic execution logs event by event.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Deterministic Replay
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Validate deterministic execution invariants (strictly ordered timestamps and seed verification) across recorded agent logs.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Tool Result Truncation
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Truncate massive tool execution outputs to protect LLM context windows while retaining critical head and tail content.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.title: Agent State Recovery
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop-prob-.description: Roll back corrupted agent memory to the most recent healthy checkpoint upon fatal tool execution exceptions.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop.title: The Agent Loop
/docs/practice-problems/agent-loop.description: Build an Agent, stage 4 of 12: This is the loop behind ReAct, Claude Code and every 'agent' framework: ask the model, run the tool it picks, append the result, ask again, and stop when it answers.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-memory-rec.title: Long-Term Memory Recall
/docs/practice-problems/agent-memory-rec.description: Build an Agent, stage 9 of 12: Trimming (stage 7) throws old turns away.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-parallel-t.title: Parallel Tool Calls With IDs
/docs/practice-problems/agent-parallel-t.description: Build an Agent, stage 8 of 12: Modern models ask for several tools in one turn (check Paris and Tokyo at once), and every result must carry the exact ID of the call it answers.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-parse-tool.title: Parse a Tool Call From Model Output
/docs/practice-problems/agent-parse-tool.description: Build an Agent, stage 1 of 12: Every agent starts here: the model replies with text, and your code has to decide whether that text is a tool call or a final answer.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-plan-and-e.title: Plan-and-Execute With Dependencies
/docs/practice-problems/agent-plan-and-e.description: Build an Agent, stage 10 of 12: ReAct decides one step at a time, and pays a model call for every step.

/docs/practice-problems/agent-validate-t.title: Validate Tool Arguments Against a Schema
/docs/practice-problems/agent-validate-t.description: Build an Agent, stage 2 of 12: Models hallucinate arguments: wrong types, missing fields, extra fields they made up.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Self-RAG: Parse Reflection Tokens Into a Retrieval Decision
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement Self-RAG's real reflection-token decision, letting the model itself decide whether a given generation step needs retrieval at all.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Parent-Document Retrieval: Map Chunk Hit to Parent
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement parent-document retrieval's core lookup: retrieve using small precise chunks for search accuracy, but return the LARGER parent chunk for generation context.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Prune Irrelevant Sentences From a Retrieved Chunk
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement sentence-level context pruning, a real technique for trimming a retrieved chunk down to only its query-relevant sentences before it consumes generation context budget.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Combine Retrieval Score With Cross-Encoder Rerank Score
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement retrieval/rerank score blending, the real final scoring step of a two-stage retrieval pipeline (cheap bi-encoder retrieval, then expensive cross-encoder reranking of the top candidates).

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Active Retrieval: Trigger Mid-Generation on Low Confidence
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement FLARE-style active retrieval triggering, deciding mid-generation whether a just-generated sentence is confident enough to keep, or uncertain enough to warrant pausing for fresh retrieval.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Align Answer Sentences to Best Supporting Chunk
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement sentence-to-source citation alignment, finding which specific retrieved chunk best supports a given generated sentence -- the real work behind an inline-citation feature.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Lost-in-the-Middle: Flag Answer-Position Risk
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement a real, simple 'lost in the middle' risk flag, based on published research showing LLMs attend less reliably to information placed in the MIDDLE of a long context versus the beginning or end.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Detect Ambiguous Query Needing Clarification
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement query-ambiguity detection, catching a real case where an agentic RAG system should ask a clarifying question rather than silently guessing which real-world entity the user meant.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Speculative RAG: Select the Best-Supported Draft Answer
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement Speculative RAG's real verification step: generate multiple candidate draft answers from different chunk subsets, then pick whichever draft is most supported by the actually-retrieved facts.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Allocate Retrieval Budget Across a Multi-Step Plan
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement retrieval-budget allocation across a multi-step agentic RAG plan, distributing a limited total number of retrieval calls proportionally to each step's real complexity.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Self-Ask: Parse Follow-Up Question Pattern
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement Self-Ask prompting's step-line parser, extracting structured meaning from the real, distinctive output format of the Self-Ask technique for decomposed multi-hop reasoning.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Corrective RAG: Grade Retrieved Document Relevance
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement Corrective RAG's real three-way relevance grading, deciding whether to proceed with retrieved documents, fall back to a web search, or blend both.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Extractive Document Compression by Top Sentences
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement extractive document compression, keeping only the highest-scored sentences of a retrieved chunk (in original reading order) before passing it to the generator -- a real, cheap alternative to abstractive (LLM-rewritten) compression.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Conversational Query Rewriting via Coreference
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement conversational query rewriting, resolving a pronoun in a follow-up question back to the real entity from the previous conversation turn -- essential for multi-turn RAG chat to retrieve correctly.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Calibrate Answer Confidence From Retrieval Score Distribution
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement retrieval-margin-based confidence calibration, a real signal distinguishing 'one document is a clear, confident match' from 'several documents are similarly, ambiguously relevant.'

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: RAG Answer Abstention Decision
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement RAG abstention, a real, honest 'I don't know' policy for when retrieval genuinely found nothing good enough to answer from, rather than forcing a generation from weak/irrelevant context.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Select Best Multi-Vector Representation for a Document
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement multi-vector representation selection, choosing WHICH of a document's several stored embeddings (full text, summary, hypothetical questions it answers) best matches a given query.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Compute Pipeline Ablation Score Delta
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement ablation-score-delta computation, the real, standard way to measure how much a specific RAG pipeline component (reranking, query rewriting, compression) actually contributes to overall quality.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Self-RAG: Parse ISREL/ISSUP/ISUSE Critique Tokens
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement Self-RAG's real critique-token decoding, translating the paper's three distinct reflection signals (relevance, support, utility) into one combined accept/reject decision.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Compute Real Retrieval Diversity via MMR-Style Redundancy Penalty
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement a real redundancy-penalty computation, the diversity half of any MMR-style diverse-retrieval selection, measuring how similar a candidate chunk is to what's already been chosen.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Determine Multi-Hop Reasoning Chain Completion
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement multi-hop reasoning-chain completion checking, the real stopping condition for an agentic RAG loop performing iterative multi-hop retrieval.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Compute Real End-to-End RAG Pipeline Latency Breakdown
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement end-to-end agentic RAG latency totaling, the real sum every user-facing latency SLA is actually measured against -- not any single stage in isolation.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Agentic Retrieval Tool Selection
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement agentic RAG tool selection, letting an agent choose between internal vector search, live web search, or no retrieval at all based on the real nature of the query.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Iterative Retrieval Stopping via Information Gain
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement iterative-retrieval stopping logic, a real decision an agentic RAG loop makes each round: keep retrieving more context, or is additional retrieval no longer worth it.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: RAG-Fusion: Reciprocal Rank Fusion Across Query Variants
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement RAG-Fusion's Reciprocal Rank Fusion, combining retrieval results from MULTIPLE generated query variants of the same original question into one robust ranked list.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Decompose a Compound Question Into Subquestions
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement real query decomposition, splitting a compound multi-part question into independently-retrievable subquestions -- a real, standard technique for questions naive single-shot retrieval handles poorly.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Adaptive Retrieval K Based on Query Complexity
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement adaptive top-k selection, retrieving more chunks for genuinely complex queries and fewer for simple ones instead of a fixed k for every query.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Self-Query: Extract Structured Metadata Filter From Natural Language
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement self-querying metadata extraction, a real technique letting a RAG system parse structured filters (year, category, author) directly out of a natural-language query rather than requiring separate filter UI.

/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.title: Answer Verification Loop Decision
/docs/practice-problems/agentic-rag-prob.description: Implement a real answer-verification decision, an agentic RAG loop's self-check step deciding whether to accept a generated answer, regenerate it, or retrieve fresh context.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Sliding-Window Text Chunking for RAG
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the overlapping sliding-window text chunker a RAG ingestion pipeline uses before embedding and indexing a document.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Correlate JSON-RPC Responses to Requests
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the request/response correlation an MCP client needs since JSON-RPC 2.0 lets responses arrive out of order.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Deterministic Canary Rollout Router
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the deterministic hash-based routing a canary rollout uses so the same request_id always sees the same model version.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Consistent Hashing Ring Lookup
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement consistent hashing, the algorithm real distributed caches and sharded databases use so adding or removing a node reshuffles only a small fraction of keys.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Hybrid Search Score Fusion
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the linear score-fusion step a hybrid vector database uses to blend keyword relevance and semantic similarity into one ranking.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: CLIP-Style Zero-Shot Classification
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the temperature-scaled softmax-over-cosine-similarity scoring behind CLIP zero-shot image classification.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Recall@K for RAG Retrieval Evaluation
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement Recall@K, the standard metric for whether a RAG pipeline's retriever actually surfaced the documents that matter.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Keyword-Based Agent Tool Router
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Route a query to the best-matching tool by counting keyword overlaps -- the cheap lexical first pass many real agent tool routers use.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Parse an MCP Resource URI
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Parse and validate the scheme of an MCP resource URI -- the check a client runs before fetching a server-exposed resource.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Compute a Latency Percentile (p95/p99)
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Compute a p95/p99 latency percentile via linear interpolation -- the real metric behind every production SLO and alert threshold.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Find When a Write Quorum Is Reached
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Find the earliest point in an ack sequence at which a distributed write reaches quorum -- the moment it's safe to acknowledge back to the client.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Parse a ReAct Agent Action String
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Parse a ReAct-style agent's free-text "Action: tool[arg]" line into a real (tool_name, argument) pair the agent loop can dispatch.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Binary-Quantized Hamming Distance Search
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Binary-quantize vectors to bitstrings and rank candidates by Hamming distance -- an extremely fast, low-memory first-pass ANN filter.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Attention-Weighted Pooling of Image Patches
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Pool per-patch embeddings into one image embedding via a normalized attention-weighted average, as a vision-language connector does.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Deduplicate Near-Identical Retrieved Passages
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Remove passages that are duplicates of an earlier one after normalization -- a cheap RAG post-retrieval cleanup pass.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Assign Subtasks to Capable Agents
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Delegate each subtask to the first agent with the required capability -- the routing decision behind a multi-agent supervisor pattern.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Negotiate MCP Client/Server Capabilities
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Compute the intersection of client and server capabilities -- the real logic behind MCP's initialize handshake.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Population Stability Index for Model Drift
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Compute the Population Stability Index between a baseline and current distribution -- the real number behind a production feature-drift alert.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Compare Two Vector Clocks
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Determine the happens-before/concurrent relationship between two vector clocks -- the real causality mechanism behind version-vector databases.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Apply Insert/Delete Operations to a Vector Index
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Simulate tombstone-based insert/delete on a vector index's live ID set -- how real ANN indexes like HNSW handle mutability.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Intersection-over-Union for Bounding Boxes
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Compute IoU between two bounding boxes -- the single most standard evaluation metric in object detection.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Jaccard Keyword Relevance for RAG Pre-Filtering
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Compute Jaccard keyword overlap between a query and a chunk -- a cheap lexical relevance signal used alongside embedding similarity.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Validate an MCP Tool-Call Payload
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the request-shape validator an MCP server runs before trusting a tool-call payload's fields and types.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Exponential Backoff Retry Delays
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Compute a capped exponential backoff retry schedule -- how an agent's tool-calling loop avoids hammering a flaky dependency.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Render an MCP Prompt Template
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Substitute named arguments into an MCP prompt template -- the rendering step behind MCP's reusable, parameterized prompt primitive.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Query a Staged Rollout Traffic Schedule
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Look up the traffic percentage in effect at a given time from a staged (blue-green) rollout schedule.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Determine a Two-Phase Commit Outcome
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Decide commit or abort from participant votes -- the coordinator's unanimous-agreement rule in Two-Phase Commit.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: IVF Coarse Quantizer: Assign a Vector to Its Cell
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Assign a query vector to its nearest centroid -- the coarse quantizer step of an IVF vector index.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Non-Maximum Suppression for Detection Boxes
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Greedily suppress overlapping lower-confidence boxes -- the final post-processing step every real object detector runs.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Merge Overlapping Retrieved Chunk Ranges
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Merge overlapping character ranges from the same source document -- avoiding redundant, overlapping RAG context fragments.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Plan-and-Execute Agents
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Check that a multi-step agent plan respects its own declared step dependencies before execution.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Cursor-Based Pagination for an MCP Tool List
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement cursor-based pagination for an MCP tools/list response, the pattern real MCP servers use for large tool sets.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Compute an Autoscaling Instance Target
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Compute the number of instances needed for a given request rate -- the core arithmetic behind a real Kubernetes HPA-style autoscaler.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Exponential Moving Average for Metric Smoothing
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the exponential moving average that smooths a noisy live metric stream into the stable signal an alerting system reacts to.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Find Replica Divergence for Anti-Entropy Repair
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Find which keys two replicas disagree on -- the divergence-detection step behind anti-entropy repair in eventually-consistent stores.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Vector Databases
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Compute a vector index's RAM footprint, with and without quantization -- the capacity-planning calculation every real deployment needs.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Aspect-Ratio-Preserving Image Resize
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Resize an image so its larger dimension hits a target size while preserving aspect ratio -- standard vision-model preprocessing.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Score RAG Answer Groundedness
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Score what fraction of a generated answer's vocabulary is traceable to the retrieved context -- a cheap RAG hallucination proxy.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Check an Agent Conversation Turn Budget
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Check whether an agent has exceeded its LLM-call turn budget -- a real safety limit distinct from consecutive tool-loop detection.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Debounce MCP Resource-Changed Notifications
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Collapse a burst of resource-changed events down to one notification per quiet window -- a real MCP server reliability pattern.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Curriculum Problem 479 (Stage 8: RAG, Agents, MCP & Distributed Systems): Master Multimodal AI.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the token-bucket algorithm real API gateways and MCP servers use to rate-limit clients while absorbing legitimate bursts.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Curriculum Problem 480 (Stage 8: RAG, Agents, MCP & Distributed Systems): Master RAG / information retrieval.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Curriculum Problem 481 (Stage 8: RAG, Agents, MCP & Distributed Systems): Master Agents / tool use.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Curriculum Problem 482 (Stage 8: RAG, Agents, MCP & Distributed Systems): Master MCP / APIs / protocols.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Curriculum Problem 483 (Stage 8: RAG, Agents, MCP & Distributed Systems): Master MLOps / data systems.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Curriculum Problem 484 (Stage 8: RAG, Agents, MCP & Distributed Systems): Master Distributed systems.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Curriculum Problem 485 (Stage 8: RAG, Agents, MCP & Distributed Systems): Master Vector search.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Calculate Multimodal Image Tile Token Cost
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Accurately compute image tile grids and token consumption for vision-language models to prevent context window exhaustion and manage API billing.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Parent-Document Chunk Linker for Hierarchical RAG
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Build the parent-document contextual retrieval pipeline that indexes small granular chunks for precise vector search but retrieves larger parent passages to preserve full context for the LLM.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Generate Agent Function Calling Tool Schema
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Build the dynamic schema generator that converts agent tool specifications into standard JSON Schema function signatures accepted by frontier LLM tool-calling APIs.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Parse MCP Server-Sent Events Transport Stream
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement the Server-Sent Events (SSE) transport parser for remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients connecting to server endpoints over HTTP.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Filtered Vector Search With a Metadata Tag
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement metadata-filtered vector search -- restrict candidates by a tag, then rank the survivors by cosine similarity, the pattern every real vector database offers.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Streaming Histogram Percentile Estimator
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement streaming histogram percentile approximation for LLM inference latency observability (P95/P99) without storing millions of individual request durations in memory.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Gossip Protocol Heartbeat Failure Detector
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement decentralized node failure detection using heartbeat gossip protocols to dynamically maintain GPU worker membership in distributed training clusters.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Product Quantization Asymmetric Distance Table
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement Asymmetric Distance Computation (ADC) used by Faiss and modern vector databases to scan millions of compressed vector codes in milliseconds without decompressing them.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: Multimodal Vision-Language Attention Mask
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement cross-modal attention masking for vision-language models (like Flamingo and LLaVA) where text can attend to images, but vision patches attend only within their respective image.

/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.title: ColBERT Late Interaction MaxSim Retrieval Score
/docs/practice-problems/agents-mcp-syste.description: Implement ColBERT's late interaction MaxSim operator, the state-of-the-art retrieval scoring mechanism that preserves token-level embeddings without collapsing documents into a single lossy vector.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: NDCG@K Ranking Quality
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement NDCG@K, the standard graded-relevance ranking metric used to evaluate recommendation and search result ordering.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Mean Average Precision at K (MAP@K)
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement Average Precision@K for one user, the per-query building block of the MAP@K metric used to evaluate recommendation ranking quality.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Recommendation Catalog Coverage
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement catalog coverage, a real diversity/business metric measuring what fraction of the entire catalog a recommender ever surfaces.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Intra-List Diversity of a Recommendation List
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement intra-list diversity, the standard metric for how varied a single recommendation list is, not just how accurate.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Popularity-Based Baseline Recommender
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the popularity baseline every real recommender system is measured against, and the standard cold-start fallback.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Content-Based Filtering Score
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the core content-based filtering score: cosine similarity between a user's preference profile and a candidate item's feature vector.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Hybrid Recommendation Score Blending
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement weighted score blending, the simplest real way to combine a collaborative-filtering model with a content-based model into one hybrid recommender.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Bayesian Personalized Ranking (BPR) Pairwise Loss
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the Bayesian Personalized Ranking loss, a real pairwise objective used to train implicit-feedback recommenders directly for ranking rather than rating prediction.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Implicit Feedback Confidence Weighting
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the real confidence-weighting formula from Hu, Koren & Volinsky's implicit-feedback ALS paper, used whenever recommendations are trained on clicks/views/plays instead of explicit star ratings.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: K-Means Centroid Update Step
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the update (M) step of Lloyd's k-means algorithm.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: K-Medoids Total Clustering Cost
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the k-medoids objective function -- like k-means but using real data points as cluster centers, more robust to outliers.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Mean Shift Update Step
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement one iteration of the mean shift algorithm, a real mode-seeking clustering method that discovers the number of clusters automatically.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Cluster Purity Score
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement cluster purity, an external validation metric that scores clustering quality against known ground-truth labels.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Adjusted Rand Index Between Two Clusterings
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the Adjusted Rand Index, the standard chance-corrected metric for comparing two clusterings (or a clustering against ground truth).

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Dunn Index Cluster Validity
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the Dunn Index, an internal cluster-validity metric that needs no ground truth -- higher is better, rewarding compact well-separated clusters.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Elbow Method: Detect the Knee in a WCSS Curve
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement a real, deterministic knee-detection rule for the elbow method, turning a subjective visual heuristic into a reproducible function.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Cold-Start Recommendation Fallback Weighting
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement a real cold-start blending weight: how much to trust personalized (CF) recommendations versus a popularity fallback, based on how much history a user actually has.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Session-Based Next-Item Markov Score
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement a first-order Markov next-item recommender, the simplest real session-based recommendation model.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Gaussian Mixture Model: Responsibility Computation
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the E-step responsibility calculation of a 1D Gaussian Mixture Model, the soft-clustering generalization of k-means.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Spectral Clustering: Gaussian Affinity Matrix
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the Gaussian (RBF) affinity matrix, the first real step of spectral clustering -- turning raw points into a similarity graph.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: DBSCAN Core Point Check
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement DBSCAN's core-point test, the primitive that makes density-based clustering possible without pre-specifying k.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Recommendation Novelty Score
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement self-information-based novelty, a real metric that scores a recommendation list on how non-obvious (unpopular) its items are.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (WCSS)
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement within-cluster sum of squares, the objective k-means directly minimizes and the core ingredient of the elbow method.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Hierarchical Clustering: Single Linkage Distance
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement single-linkage (nearest-neighbor) inter-cluster distance for agglomerative hierarchical clustering.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Hierarchical Clustering: Complete Linkage Distance
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement complete-linkage (farthest-neighbor) inter-cluster distance, the opposite bias to single linkage.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Hierarchical Clustering: Average Linkage Distance
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement average-linkage inter-cluster distance, a compromise between single and complete linkage's biases.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: Jaccard Similarity for Collaborative Filtering
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement Jaccard similarity, a simple but real similarity metric used in item-based collaborative filtering on implicit (binary) interaction data.

/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.title: User-Based Collaborative Filtering Prediction
/docs/practice-problems/cluster-rec-prob.description: Implement the real user-based collaborative filtering prediction formula: a similarity-weighted average of neighbors' ratings for an unseen item.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-16.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-16.description: Implement Remove Nth Node From End of List using the two-pointer gap trick -- a single-pass technique applicable to any "find the k-th node from the end" problem.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-17.title: Symmetric Tree
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-17.description: Implement Symmetric Tree -- checking mirror-image structure via paired recursion, the base pattern for Subtree of Another Tree and Same Tree.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-18.title: Clone Graph
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-18.description: Implement Clone Graph via BFS -- the adjacency-list representation makes both DFS and BFS solutions straightforward, and this is the base pattern for any "duplicate this connected structure" problem.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-19.title: Coin Change (Minimum Coins)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-19.description: Implement Coin Change (Minimum Coins) -- the canonical unbounded-knapsack DP problem, sharing the same recurrence shape as Climbing Stairs but with arbitrary step sizes.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-2.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-2.description: Implement Binary Tree Level Order Traversal with BFS -- the foundational breadth-first tree pattern every zigzag/right-side-view/connect-pointers variant reuses.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-20.title: Implement Stack using Queues
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-20.description: Implement Stack using Queues -- the inverse of Queue using Stacks. Making push expensive (O(n)) instead of pop/top is what makes a single queue behave like a stack.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-21.title: Palindrome Linked List
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-21.description: Implement Palindrome Linked List -- combining traversal and reversal-style thinking. The straightforward O(n)-space version collects values into a list; the O(1)-space version finds the middle and reverses the second half.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-22.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of BST
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-22.description: Implement Lowest Common Ancestor of a BST, exploiting BST ordering to find the LCA with no extra memory and O(h) time -- the general (non-BST) version needs a different, more expensive approach.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-23.title: Number of Connected Components (Union-Find)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-23.description: Implement Number of Connected Components using Union-Find -- the canonical disjoint-set data structure, introducing path compression for near-O(1) operations.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-24.title: Unique Paths
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-24.description: Implement Unique Paths -- a 2-D DP problem where each cell sums the cell above and the cell to its left. The closed-form answer is a binomial coefficient, but the DP generalizes cleanly to grids with obstacles.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-25.title: LRU Cache
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-25.description: Implement an LRU Cache -- the classic hashmap + ordering structure behind essentially every production caching layer.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-26.title: Add Two Numbers
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-26.description: Implement Add Two Numbers -- ripple-carry addition performed directly on linked lists, testing carry propagation and simultaneous list construction.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-27.title: Binary Tree Right Side View
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-27.description: Implement Binary Tree Right Side View -- BFS level order that only records the last node visited at each level, giving exactly the silhouette visible from the right.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-28.title: Course Schedule (Cycle Detection in DAG)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-28.description: Implement Course Schedule using three-color DFS cycle detection -- the foundational algorithm behind build systems, package managers, and task schedulers that must detect circular dependencies.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-29.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-29.description: Implement Longest Increasing Subsequence with the patience-sort / binary-search technique -- O(n log n), a major upgrade over the naive O(n^2) DP.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-3.title: Number of Islands
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-3.description: Implement Number of Islands with DFS -- the canonical grid connected-components problem underlying Flood Fill, Pacific Atlantic Water Flow, and Surrounded Regions.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-30.title: Design HashMap
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-30.description: Implement Reorder List by combining three classic linked-list techniques: find the middle, reverse the second half, then interleave the two halves.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-31.title: Reorder List
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-31.description: Implement Linked Lists: Reorder List in the Data Structures & Algorithms track of the 1,000+ problem Neural Mastery AI Engineering curriculum.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-32.title: Path Sum II (All Paths)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-32.description: Implement Path Sum II using DFS with backtracking -- the template that underlies Subsets, Permutations, and Combinations.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-33.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-33.description: Implement 0/1 Knapsack, the classic bounded DP -- every "pick or skip each item once" problem is a variant of this shape.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-34.title: 0/1 Knapsack
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-34.description: Implement DP: 0/1 Knapsack in the Data Structures & Algorithms track of the 1,000+ problem Neural Mastery AI Engineering curriculum.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-35.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-35.description: Implement a Trie (prefix tree) from scratch -- the core data structure behind autocomplete, spell-checkers, and IP routing tables.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-36.title: Sort Linked List (Merge Sort)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-36.description: Implement Sort Linked List with merge sort -- O(n log n), and the algorithm that fits linked lists naturally since splitting at the middle is an O(n) pointer walk, not an array copy.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-37.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-37.description: Implement Validate Binary Search Tree by passing down a valid (min, max) range at each node -- comparing only to immediate children is a common wrong approach that misses violations from further-up ancestors.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-38.title: Walls and Gates (Multi-source BFS)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-38.description: Implement Edit Distance (Levenshtein) -- the classic 2-D string-alignment DP, where dp[i][j] is the minimum edits to convert the first i characters of word1 into the first j characters of word2.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-39.title: Edit Distance (Levenshtein)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-39.description: Implement DP: Edit Distance (Levenshtein) in the Data Structures & Algorithms track of the 1,000+ problem Neural Mastery AI Engineering curriculum.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-4.title: Climbing Stairs
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-4.description: Implement Climbing Stairs, the simplest possible DP problem -- the answer is exactly Fibonacci(n+1), and it is the standard first example for the recurrence -> memo -> bottom-up -> O(1)-space progression.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-40.title: Word Search (Backtracking on Grid)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-40.description: Implement Word Search using DFS backtracking on a grid -- the mark/recurse/unmark template that underlies every "search all paths through a grid without reusing cells" problem.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-41.title: Rotate List
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-41.description: Implement Rotate List by temporarily making the list circular, then cutting it at the correct point -- the modulo step handles k values larger than the list length efficiently.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-42.title: Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-42.description: Implement Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List with a post-order recursive approach -- processing the right subtree first is what enables doing this with only O(h) extra space.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-43.title: Minimum Spanning Tree (Kruskal)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-43.description: Implement Minimum Spanning Tree via Kruskal's algorithm -- sort edges by cost, then greedily add the cheapest edge that does not create a cycle, using Union-Find to detect cycles in O(alpha(n)) per check.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-44.title: Coin Change II (Count Combinations)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-44.description: Implement Coin Change II -- counting combinations (not permutations) with unlimited coins. Unlike Coin Change (minimum coins), the ORDER in which coins are chosen must not matter here, which changes how the DP loops must be nested.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-45.title: Design Twitter (Simplified Feed)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-45.description: Implement a simplified Twitter feed -- a practical combination of hash maps and timestamp-ordered event streams, the kind of system-design-adjacent problem that shows up once basic data structures feel comfortable.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-46.title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-46.description: Implement Swap Nodes in Pairs with a dummy head, swapping the two nodes in each pair by rewiring pointers rather than copying values.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-47.title: All Nodes Distance K in Binary Tree
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-47.description: Implement All Nodes Distance K by first building parent pointers, then BFS-ing from the target treating the tree as an UNDIRECTED graph -- distance can go through parents, not just children.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-48.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops (Bellman-Ford)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-48.description: Implement Cheapest Flights Within K Stops with a stop-limited variant of Bellman-Ford -- capping the number of relaxation rounds at k+1 is what enforces the stops constraint (Dijkstra's greedy approach does not respect a stops limit correctly).

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-49.title: Word Break II (All Sentences)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-49.description: Implement Word Break II by enumerating all valid segmentations with top-down memoization -- the exponential-sized output is unavoidable, but memoization avoids recomputing shared subproblems.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-5.title: Valid Parentheses
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-5.description: Implement is_valid(s) -- the canonical stack problem.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-50.title: Maximum Frequency Stack
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-50.description: Implement Maximum Frequency Stack -- tracking per-element push counts AND grouping elements by their current frequency is what enables an O(1) pop of the most-frequent (most-recent-on-tie) element.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-51.title: Reverse Nodes in k-Group
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-51.description: Implement Reverse Nodes in k-Group by combining group-length verification, in-place reversal (same as Reverse Linked List), and careful pointer re-wiring between groups.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-52.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-52.description: Implement Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum -- at each node, track the best "single-arm" contribution usable by the parent, while separately updating a global best for paths that bend through this node using both arms.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-53.title: Word Ladder (BFS Shortest Transformation)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-53.description: Implement Word Ladder with BFS, where the implicit graph has an edge between any two words differing by exactly one letter -- BFS naturally finds the SHORTEST such transformation.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-54.title: Regular Expression Matching
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-54.description: Implement Regular Expression Matching with 2-D DP -- a classic hard DP problem where careful case analysis of the `*` operator (zero occurrences vs. one more occurrence) is the entire difficulty.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-55.title: Find Median from Data Stream
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-55.description: Implement Find Median from Data Stream using two heaps -- a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half -- giving O(log n) inserts and O(1) median queries.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-56.title: Merge K Sorted Lists
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-56.description: Implement Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree using preorder encoding with explicit null markers -- the same iterator-based decoding approach generalizes to any preorder or level-order tree encoding.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-57.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-57.description: Implement Trees: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree in the Data Structures & Algorithms track of the 1,000+ problem Neural Mastery AI Engineering curriculum.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-58.title: Alien Dictionary (Topological Sort)
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-58.description: Implement Alien Dictionary by extracting pairwise ordering constraints from adjacent words, then running a DFS-based topological sort -- a cycle in the constraint graph means no valid alphabet order exists.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-59.title: Burst Balloons
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-59.description: Implement Burst Balloons with interval DP -- the key insight is to think about which balloon is burst LAST in a range, not first, since that fixes stable neighbors for the DP transition.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-6.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-6.description: Implement Merge Two Sorted Lists -- the merge step from Merge Sort, and the base case Merge K Sorted Lists reduces to.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-60.title: Sliding Window Maximum
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-60.description: Implement vectorized min-max normalization in NumPy to scale numerical feature values into the range [0.0, 1.0].

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-7.title: Count Nodes in Complete Binary Tree
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-7.description: Implement Count Nodes in a Complete Binary Tree -- tree recursion in its simplest form, with an efficient O(log^2 n) approach that exploits the completeness property.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-8.title: Flood Fill
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-8.description: Implement Flood Fill, the paint-bucket algorithm -- a direct DFS/BFS application on a 2D grid and a template for grid-traversal problems generally.

/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-9.title: House Robber
/docs/practice-problems/ds-algo-prob-9.description: Implement rob(nums) -- the classic 1-D DP problem with the recurrence dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i]), implementable in O(1) space.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-1.title: Exact-Match Task Accuracy
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-1.description: Implement exact-match accuracy, the simplest real agent-evaluation metric -- what fraction of outputs are byte-for-byte identical to the expected answer.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-10.title: Regression Detection Between Two Eval Runs
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-10.description: Implement eval regression detection, finding SPECIFIC test cases that flipped from passing to failing between two versions -- more actionable than comparing aggregate scores alone.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-11.title: Compute Real Cost Per Eval Run
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-11.description: Implement real eval-run cost computation, since input and output tokens are typically priced differently and a full eval suite run against a real API genuinely costs money.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-12.title: Statistical Significance of an Eval Score Delta
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-12.description: Implement statistical-significance testing for an eval score comparison, the real gate before claiming 'model B genuinely beats model A' rather than a difference explainable by eval-set sample noise.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-13.title: Compute Real Token Usage Cost Attribution by User
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-13.description: Implement per-user cost attribution, a real observability requirement for any multi-tenant agent deployment needing to bill or budget-track individual users.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-14.title: Detect Silent Eval Harness Failures
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-14.description: Implement silent-failure detection in an eval harness, catching test cases that neither clearly passed nor clearly failed -- a real, common eval-infrastructure bug that silently inflates or deflates reported scores.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-15.title: Weighted Composite Eval Score
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-15.description: Implement weighted composite scoring, combining several individually-meaningful eval metrics (accuracy, latency, cost) into one real overall number for a leaderboard or gating decision.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-16.title: Sliding Window Error Rate Monitoring
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-16.description: Implement sliding-window error-rate monitoring, giving a real-time observability dashboard a responsive, recency-weighted error signal instead of an all-time cumulative average that reacts too slowly to a fresh incident.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-17.title: Extract Structured Tool-Call Events From a Trace
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-17.description: Implement tool-call event extraction from a raw agent execution trace, the real filtering step behind a 'show me every tool this agent called' observability view.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-18.title: Compute Eval Confidence Interval (Wilson Score)
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-18.description: Implement the Wilson score confidence interval, a real, more statistically sound alternative to a naive normal-approximation interval for reporting uncertainty on a small-sample eval pass rate.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-19.title: Alert Deduplication by Fingerprint
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-19.description: Implement alert deduplication, a real, necessary filter preventing an observability system from paging an on-call engineer once per occurrence of what's really the same ongoing incident.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-2.title: LLM-as-Judge Score Normalization
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-2.description: Implement judge-score normalization, converting an LLM-as-judge's raw rating (on whatever scale the judge prompt used) into a standard [0,1] range for aggregation across differently-scaled evaluations.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-20.title: Compute Real Answer Diversity Across Sampled Generations
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-20.description: Implement self-consistency rate calculation, a real reliability signal from sampling an agent's answer to the SAME question multiple times -- high agreement across samples correlates with genuine confidence.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-21.title: Detect Metric Drift Between Deploys
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-21.description: Implement deploy-over-deploy metric drift detection, a real automated check comparing a new deployment's key metric against the historical distribution from prior deploys.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-22.title: Build a Real-Time Dashboard Rollup Window
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-22.description: Implement time-bucket assignment for dashboard rollups, the real primitive behind aggregating a high-volume event stream into fixed-size time windows for display.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-23.title: Compute Real Precision and Recall for a Binary Judge
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-23.description: Implement precision and recall computation for a binary agent classification/judgment task, the standard real metrics distinguishing two different real error costs (false positives vs. false negatives).

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-24.title: Detect Flaky Test Cases Across Repeated Eval Runs
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-24.description: Implement flaky-test detection across repeated eval runs, catching test cases whose result genuinely isn't deterministic -- a real, important distinction from tests that reliably pass or reliably fail.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-25.title: Compute Real Token-Efficiency Score
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-25.description: Implement token-efficiency scoring, a real metric capturing that a SUCCESSFUL agent using fewer tokens than a baseline is genuinely more efficient, while a failed run should score zero regardless of token usage.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-26.title: Correlate Metric Anomaly With Deploy Event
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-26.description: Implement deploy-correlation checking, a real, first diagnostic step whenever an observability system flags an anomaly -- was this caused by a recent deploy, or something else entirely.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-27.title: Compute Real Judge-Model Bias Toward Position
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-27.description: Implement position-bias detection for an LLM-as-judge pairwise comparison setup, a real, well-documented failure mode where judges systematically favor whichever answer appears first/second regardless of actual quality.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-28.title: Compute Real Uptime SLA Percentage
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-28.description: Implement uptime percentage calculation, the real, direct arithmetic behind reporting an agent-serving system's SLA compliance (e.g. 'three nines' = 99.9%).

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-29.title: Aggregate Multi-Turn Conversation Success Rate
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-29.description: Implement conversation-level (not turn-level) success rate computation, the real metric that actually matters for a multi-turn agent -- a conversation with even one broken turn is usually a real failed user experience overall.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-3.title: Inter-Rater Agreement (Cohen's Kappa)
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-3.description: Implement Cohen's Kappa, the real, standard statistic for measuring agreement between two evaluators (human or LLM-judge) beyond what chance alone would predict.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-4.title: Structured Log Line Formatting
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-4.description: Implement structured JSON log-line formatting, the real, standard output format an observability pipeline (not humans) actually needs to parse agent logs reliably.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-5.title: Compute Eval Suite Pass Rate by Category
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-5.description: Implement per-category eval pass-rate breakdown, a real diagnostic step revealing WHICH kind of task an agent is actually weak on, rather than one opaque overall score.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-6.title: Token-Level F1 Score for Answer Matching
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-6.description: Implement token-level F1 score, the standard soft-matching metric (as used in SQuAD-style QA evaluation) for comparing a free-text agent answer against a reference answer.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-7.title: Detect Test-Set Contamination via Overlap
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-7.description: Implement a real, simple contamination check, flagging when eval benchmark examples appear to overlap with training data -- a genuine, common cause of inflated eval scores that don't reflect real generalization.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-8.title: Compute Distributed Trace Span Duration
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-8.description: Implement trace-span duration calculation, the basic real building block of any observability trace visualization for an agent's multi-step execution.

/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-9.title: Aggregate Trace Spans Into a Tree
/docs/practice-problems/eval-obs-prob-9.description: Implement span-tree reconstruction, assembling flat trace spans (each with a parent reference) into the real hierarchical call tree an observability UI actually displays.

/docs/practice-problems/find-duplicates.title: Find All Duplicates in an Array
/docs/practice-problems/find-duplicates.description: Find all duplicates in a bounded-range array in O(n) time and O(1) extra space using the cyclic-sort sign-flipping technique, no set or counting array.

/docs/practice-problems/find-rotation-po.title: Find the Rotation Point
/docs/practice-problems/find-rotation-po.description: Find the rotation point in a rotated sorted array in O(log n) time -- binary search comparing against the endpoint, not a fixed target, with real code.

/docs/practice-problems/first-failure-in.title: Read the Logs Before the Code
/docs/practice-problems/first-failure-in.description: Specify, Verify, Debug, stage 3 of 12: At 14:03 checkout starts failing.

/docs/practice-problems/gap-in-the-seque.title: The Gap in the Sequence
/docs/practice-problems/gap-in-the-seque.description: Find a missing number in a sequence of n distinct integers in O(n) time and O(1) space using a closed-form triangular-number sum trick.

/docs/practice-problems/gradient-descent.title: One Gradient Descent Step for Linear Regression
/docs/practice-problems/gradient-descent.description: Implement one real full-batch gradient descent step for linear regression -- derive and apply the exact w/b update rule, not just call an optimizer.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Find Center of Star Graph
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Identify the central hub node of a star graph in constant O(1) time.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Kruskal's Minimum Spanning Tree Weight
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Calculate the total weight of a Minimum Spanning Tree using Kruskal's greedy edge selection.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Course Schedule: Cycle Detection in Directed Graph
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Determine whether a course dependency graph contains cycles using Kahn's BFS topological sort.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Course Schedule II: Topological Order Recovery
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Generate a valid linear sequence to complete all prerequisite courses using Kahn's topological sort.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Number of Islands in 2D Grid
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Count disconnected land masses in a 2D matrix using connected component search.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Rotting Oranges: Multi-Source BFS
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Simulate synchronous disease propagation in a grid using multi-source Breadth-First Search.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Dijkstra's Single-Source Shortest Paths
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Find shortest paths from a source to all nodes in a weighted graph using Dijkstra's algorithm.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Deep Clone Graph Structure
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Deep copy a node and its recursive graph neighborhood preserving cyclic topology.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Network Delay Time via Dijkstra
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Measure signal latency across a directed network using single-source shortest paths.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Redundant Connection in Graph
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Identify the edge completing a cycle in a near-tree graph using Union-Find.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Find the cheapest flight path bounded by at most k intermediate stops using Bellman-Ford step relaxation.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Find if Path Exists in Graph
/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.description: Determine graph reachability between two vertices using BFS or DFS traversal.

/docs/practice-problems/graph-algo-prob-.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points (Prim's MST)
